z-m-27-01.title: Hanyoyi nawa ne ake da su na raba alewa 6?
z-m-27-01.topic: Yawan hanyoyin raba alewa: ko ana bambanta alewa da ko ana yarda wani ya rasa
z-m-27-01.goal: Ka fahimci cewa jimlar ‘yawan hanyoyin rabawa’ kaɗai ba ta kayyade amsa guda ɗaya ba, sannan ka sake rubuta matsalar ta hanyar bayyana sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata domin tantance amsa (ko ana bambanta alewa da ko ana yarda hannu ya zama babu komai).
z-m-27-01.material: Muna son raba alewa 6 duka ga mutane uku, 갑, 을, 병. Sunayen 갑, 을, 병 tabbatattu ne, saboda haka mutane ne daban-daban. Ana ƙirga hanyoyin rabawa bisa sakamakon ‘wa ya karɓi me’. Idan sakamakon iri ɗaya ne, hanya ɗaya ce, kuma ba a ƙirga jerin bayar da alewar ba. Matsalar jimla ɗaya ce kawai: ‘Hanyoyi nawa ne ake da su na raba alewa 6 ga mutane uku?’
z-m-27-01.thinking.0: Yanke shawarar ko bayanin ya isa kafin nemo amsa
z-m-27-01.thinking.1: Hasashen yadda yawan lokuta yake canzawa idan sharuɗɗa suka canza
z-m-27-01.thinking.2: Bincikawa ta ƙirƙirar lokuta masu sharuɗɗa tabbatattu
z-m-27-01.thinking.3: Sake rubuta matsala marar bayyananniyar ma'ana ta yadda za ta sami amsa guda ɗaya
z-m-27-01.prereq.0: Rubuta lokuta a matsayin nau'i-nau'i masu jeri, sannan ka jera su ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ba
z-m-27-01.prereq.1: Ka'idar ninkawa da ka'idar jimilla (matakin farkon sashen ‘ƙidaya lokuta’ a Lissafi na gama-gari na babbar sakandare)
z-m-27-01.prereq.2: H2 a aikin matakin makaranta alamar wahala ce kawai a wannan shirin samarwa, ba rarrabawa zuwa ajin makaranta ba. Ka ɗauka an riga an koya ainihin ra'ayoyin sashen ƙidayar lokuta.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.prompt: Domin jimlar guda ɗaya ta sami amsa guda ɗaya, me kuma dole ne mu sani? Zaɓi duk abin da ya dace.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka raba kamar kana zana layi tsakanin sharuɗɗan da aka riga aka rubuta a bayanin matsala da waɗanda ba a rubuta ba.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka kayyade rabon guda ɗaya na (갑, 을, 병) domin sakamakon ya kasance iri ɗaya, sannan ka yi tunanin wane sharaɗi idan aka sauya shi zai sa sakamakon ya bambanta ko ya gagara.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.a: Shekarun mutanen nan uku 갑, 을, 병
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.a: Shekaru ba su da alaƙa da yawan hanyoyin raba alewa. Ka yi tunanin wane bayani ne ke canza yadda ake ƙidaya.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.b: Ko ana bambanta alewa 6 da juna
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka lura cewa bisa ko ana bambanta alewa, rabon adadi iri ɗaya ma ana iya ƙidaya shi a matsayin hanyoyi daban-daban.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.c: Ko ana bayar da alewa ɗaya bayan ɗaya a jere ko duka lokaci guda
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.c: An tsara matsalar a ƙirga sakamako kawai, ba jerin bayarwa ba. Wannan sharaɗi an riga an fayyace shi.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.d: Ko babu laifi idan ɗaya daga cikin mutanen uku bai samu ko alewa ɗaya ba
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.d: Ka lura cewa ko an haɗa lokutan da wani ya karɓi 0 yana sauya jerin lokuta masu yiwuwa gaba ɗaya.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.e: Ko 갑, 을, 병 mutane daban-daban ne
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.e: An riga an rubuta cewa suna da sunaye tabbatattu. Ka bambanta bayanin da aka bayar da wanda ya ɓace.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.explain: Akwai bayanai biyu da suka ɓace. Bisa ko ana bambanta alewa, ko adadin rabon iri ɗaya ne kamar (갑 4, 을 1, 병 1), ana iya ƙidaya shi a matsayin hanya dabam idan alewar da aka karɓa ta bambanta. Haka kuma lokuta masu yiwuwa suna canzawa bisa ko ana yarda wani ya rasa alewa. An riga an bayar da cewa ana bambanta mutanen da cewa ba a ƙirga jerin bayarwa ba.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.prompt: Mu kayyade yanayin da alewa 6 duka iri ɗaya ce kuma kowanne daga cikin mutanen uku yana samun aƙalla 1. Shigar da hanyoyi daban-daban guda 6. (yawan da 갑 ya samu shi ne a, na 을 shi ne b, na 병 kuma c)
z-m-27-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka yanke shawarar adadin da mutum guda zai samu, sannan ka duba abin da jimillar adadin sauran biyun dole ta zama.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.hint.1: (4,1,1) da (1,4,1) hanya ɗaya ce kuwa? Ka kwatanta da ma'aunin da ke cikin bayanin matsalar: ‘idan sakamakon iri ɗaya ne, hanya ɗaya ce.’
z-m-27-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan mutanen uku sun samu aƙalla 1.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole kowanne daga cikin mutanen ukun ya samu aƙalla 1.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Ba za a iya raba alewa ba, saboda haka adadin lamba cikakkiya ce.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole yawan alewa ya zama lamba cikakkiya.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Jimillar adadin da mutanen uku suka samu dole ta zama 6.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.explain: A ƙarƙashin wannan sharaɗi akwai hanyoyi 10 duka. Ana ƙirga (1,1,4), (1,4,1), da (4,1,1) a matsayin hanyoyi daban-daban domin mutumin da ya samu alewa 4 ya bambanta. Dalili shi ne ana bambanta mutanen ukun. Ko rukuni ɗaya na lambobi (1,2,3) yana kasuwa zuwa hanyoyi 6 bisa wanda ya karɓi nawa.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon ka ɗauka alewa 6 duk ɗanɗanonsu daban ne, kuma babu laifi idan wani bai samu ba. Idan aka kwatanta da raba alewa iri ɗaya tare da yarda wasu hannu ya zama babu komai (hanyoyi 28), me zai faru da yawan hanyoyi?
z-m-27-01.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi rabo ɗaya daga yanayin alewa iri ɗaya, (4,1,1), sannan ka nemo kai tsaye hanyoyi nawa wannan rabon yake kasuwa idan ana bambanta alewa.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yanke shawara ga kowace alewa ɗaya bayan ɗaya: ‘wanene daga cikin mutanen uku zai karɓe ta’, sannan ka ƙidaya sau nawa wannan zaɓin yake maimaituwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.a: Yana raguwa. Domin dole a bambanta alewa, sharaɗin ya fi tsauri.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.a: Bambanta alewa ba ya sa wani rabon da zai yiwu ya ɓace. Ka duba hanyoyi nawa rabon adadi ɗaya yake kasuwa zuwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.b: Iri ɗaya ne, hanyoyi 28. Domin yawan alewa da yawan mutane ba su canza ba.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.b: Ko yawan alewa da mutane iri ɗaya ne, a rabon (4,1,1) iri ɗaya, hanya ce dabam idan alewar da kowanne ya samu ta bambanta.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.c: Yana ƙaruwa. Domin rabo guda yana kasuwa zuwa hanyoyi da dama.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.c: Ka nuna cewa da zarar an bambanta alewa, rabo guda yana kasuwa zuwa hanyoyi da dama.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.d: Ba za mu sani ba sai mun warware abin da ke faruwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.d: Za ka iya kwatanta girman adadin ba tare da lissafa komai ba, ta duba rabo guda da yawan hanyoyin da ya kasu zuwa kawai.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.explain: Idan alewar duka daban-daban ce, kowace alewa tana zaɓar ɗaya daga cikin mutane uku, saboda haka 3 a ƙarfin 6 ne, wato hanyoyi 729. Wannan ya fi hanyoyi 28 na alewa iri ɗaya nesa ba kusa ba. Dalili shi ne kowanne daga cikin hanyoyi 28 yana kasuwa zuwa hanyoyi da dama. Misali, ko (4,1,1) shi kaɗai yana kasuwa zuwa da dama bisa waɗanne alewa 4 ne 갑 ya karɓa.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.prompt: Ka gyara jimlar farko, ka rubuta matsalar ta fassarori daban-daban biyu domin kowacce ta sami amsa guda ɗaya. Ba sai ka nemo amsoshin (yawan hanyoyi) ba, amma ka bayyana sharuɗɗan da ka ƙara a sarari.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.hint.0: Ka kayyade bayanai biyun da suka ɓace da ka zaɓa tun farko, ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan ka saka su cikin jimlar.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.hint.1: Fassarori biyun dole su bambanta da aƙalla sharaɗi guda. Ka yanke shawarar sharaɗin da za ka canza, sannan ka rubuta shi.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Za ka iya faɗin sharaɗin da ya bambanta tsakanin fassarori biyun da ka rubuta a layi guda?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Idan aka karanta kowace fassara, za a iya gane ko alewar iri ɗaya ce ko ana bambanta ta kuwa?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: A kowace fassara, za a iya gane ko babu laifi idan wani bai samu alewa ba kuwa?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.model.0: Fassara 1) Alewa 6 duka iri ɗaya ce, kuma babu laifi idan mutum bai samu 0 ba. Fassara 2) Alewa 6 duk ɗanɗanonsu daban ne, kuma babu laifi idan wani bai samu ko alewa 1 ba.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.model.1: Ana iya rubuta ta a matsayin yawan hanyoyin raba alewa 6 iri ɗaya domin kowanne daga cikin mutane ukun ya samu aƙalla 1, ko kuma yawan hanyoyin raba alewa 6 daban-daban domin kada kowa ya rasa.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Wannan amsa ta zaɓi haɗin sharuɗɗa na uku (ana bambanta alewa + kowa ya samu aƙalla 1). Ko haɗin ya bambanta, amsa ce ingantacciya muddin sharuɗɗan sun bayyana sarai.
